messages:
erin: quick report — sampleapp onboarding is showing repeated retries for users who hit a malformed metadata error. Support tickets piling up.

noah: where is this coming from? server side 400?

erin: yes. server returns 400 with body like { "error": { "kind": "parse_error", "message": "expected object for metadata" } }. our JS SDK surfaces a generic BadRequest with only status code.

tanya: that means user code treats it as retriable in some places. We should distinguish parse vs validation vs auth.

noah: minimal change plan: SDK looks for `error.kind` and maps it to typed exceptions: ParseError, ValidationError, AuthError, RateLimitError. default to BadRequest only if nothing matches.

der-bot: Action created: DX-981 standardize SDK error mapping.

erin: also add human-friendly message and a docs hint link in the exception: e.g., "Malformed metadata — expected JSON object. See: /docs/sampleapp/metadata". keeps support load down.

tanya: for backwards compatibility, SDKs should fall back to heuristics when `error.kind` missing: check `Retry-After` header for 429, message regex for 'token'->AuthError, 'expected'/'invalid' -> Parse/Validation.

lee: small code snippet idea for Node: `const kind = payload?.error?.kind || inferKindFrom(payload);` then throw mapped error classes.

erin: tests: add unit tests covering payloads with/without `error.kind`, and an e2e where sampleapp sends bad metadata to ensure onboarding stops retrying.

noah: who will own TS + Go? I can take JS/TS. erin takes Go. tanya will draft docs & sampleapp README updates.

der-bot: Noted: linked RN-447 (server standardize error.kind) to DX-981.

erin: timeline: quick patch this week to reduce support noise. I'll open PRs against both SDKs.

tanya: UX note — exceptions should include `code` (machine id) and `help_url`. copy example: `code: ERR_PARSE_METADATA`, `help_url: https://redwood.ai/docs/sampleapp/metadata#errors`.

noah: also expose a boolean `retriable` on error objects to make sampleapp retry policy explicit.

erin: agreed. sampleapp will change from `retryOnAnyError` to `if (err.retriable) retryWithBackoff()`

lee: one edge: mocks in CI return old error shape. will coordinate with infra to update test fixtures.

noah: cool. PRs by EOD Friday?

erin: yes. i'll drop PR links and a quick changelog line: "SDK: map server error.kind to typed exceptions; add retriable flag and help_url"

tanya: thanks all. small change but should cut 70% of those tickets. :sparkles:
